paragraphs: Hyman cites Bereshit Rabbah 58:2: on the day R' Avin died, his son R' Avin was born. See the entry Ravin, where Hyman says he has discussed this at length.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Bereshit Rabbah 58:2 has the corresponding Avun/Avun-his-son death-and-birth account. Hyman’s spelling Avin is retained; this is not the parashah name Noach.

The whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 58:2 paragraph says that on the day Rabbi Avun died Rabbi Avun his son was born. Hyman’s Avin spelling and Ravin pointer remain distinct; Avin uses R' without transferring a full title from Avun. The account and Hyman’s discussion reference remain attributed, with the existing note verbatim and no chronology or genealogy admission.
